anchors.name: Dark Technical Investor Deck
anchors.visual_thesis: A serious dark control room where the product reveals a hidden layer of reality.
anchors.typography: Mono labels and numbers, clean sans body, occasional serif display for human/emotional claims.
anchors.layout_grammar: Top system chrome, left thesis or chart, right micro-case/sidebar, thin rules, corner brackets, terminal/status modules.
anchors.motion: Slow signal sweep, chart reveal, terminal cursor, section crossfade; never playful bounce.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use layered panels, canvas/WebGL atmospherics, SVG data overlays, and screenshot-backed proof pages.

anchors.name: Studio Product Keynote
anchors.visual_thesis: One product promise at a time, staged like a launch film with tactile product moments.
anchors.typography: Large confident sans headlines, minimal body, precise labels near product/UI.
anchors.layout_grammar: Full-bleed product moments, centered hero claims, wide gutters, sparse copy, section title cards.
anchors.motion: Spatial zoom, product parallax, staged reveals, shared-element transitions.
anchors.html_first_notes: Prioritize high-fidelity product imagery, video-like transitions, and stage lighting; export PDF after visual QA.

anchors.name: Swiss Consulting Brief
anchors.visual_thesis: A precise executive argument where every page title states the answer.
anchors.typography: Neutral sans, strong title/body contrast, tabular numbers, restrained bold.
anchors.layout_grammar: Strict grid, answer-first headlines, issue trees, scenario tables, value bridges, narrow annotations.
anchors.motion: Minimal: build tables row-by-row only when presenting live.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use HTML tables/SVG charts for precision; keep print/PDF output crisp.

anchors.name: Data Desk Board Review
anchors.visual_thesis: A newsroom-grade data desk: clear metrics, visible changes, and one decision per page.
anchors.typography: Sans for explanation, mono/tabular figures for metrics, compact captions.
anchors.layout_grammar: KPI strip, primary chart, variance callout, right-side driver notes, source footer.
anchors.motion: Data draw-on, threshold marker reveal, no decorative flourish.
anchors.html_first_notes: HTML-first enables sharp custom charts and interactive drill hints; export static PDF for board packet.

anchors.name: Editorial Research Atlas
anchors.visual_thesis: A high-end magazine feature that turns findings into a guided atlas.
anchors.typography: Serif display for findings, humanist sans body, small caps captions.
anchors.layout_grammar: Hero finding pages, image crops, marginalia, pull quotes, chapter openers, annotated charts.
anchors.motion: Page-turn crossfade, gentle map pan, annotation reveal.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use editorial scroll-like section rhythm inside slide sequence; keep citations readable.

anchors.name: Calm Clinical Trust
anchors.visual_thesis: A humane clinical brief: soft surfaces, careful evidence, and no hype.
anchors.typography: Highly legible sans, moderate weights, generous line height.
anchors.layout_grammar: Soft panels, patient journey, protocol steps, evidence notes, conservative charts.
anchors.motion: Subtle fade and step progression; avoid flashy transitions.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use warm imagery or abstract clinical diagrams; cite sources and keep claims conservative.

anchors.name: Premium Minimal Luxury
anchors.visual_thesis: Restraint as confidence: sparse composition, material cues, and slow reveal.
anchors.typography: Elegant serif display plus quiet sans captions; fewer words, larger spacing.
anchors.layout_grammar: One hero object/image, wide margins, thin rules, asymmetry, captioned proof.
anchors.motion: Slow opacity/scale, material lighting, no kinetic gimmicks.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use high-resolution product/place imagery and controlled negative space.

anchors.name: Paper Learning Workshop
anchors.visual_thesis: A guided worksheet: learners see progress, examples, mistakes, and practice.
anchors.typography: Friendly sans, occasional handwritten annotation style, clear hierarchy.
anchors.layout_grammar: Notebook tabs, step blocks, worked examples, practice prompts, mistake callouts.
anchors.motion: Step reveal and annotation drawing; keep classroom pace calm.
anchors.html_first_notes: HTML-first supports interactive-looking exercises while final PDF remains readable.

anchors.name: Bold Founder Manifesto
anchors.visual_thesis: A series of unforgettable posters that make the thesis feel inevitable.
anchors.typography: Massive condensed or grotesque headlines; very little body copy.
anchors.layout_grammar: Full-slide declarations, brutal crop, one icon/object, proof slides as interruptions.
anchors.motion: Hard cuts, type slam, poster stack reveal; still respect reduced motion.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use CSS typography and image masks for poster-level control.

anchors.name: Product Demo Workbench
anchors.visual_thesis: The buyer sees their workflow before and after the product.
anchors.typography: Product UI sans, tabular metrics, concise benefit labels.
anchors.layout_grammar: Workflow lane, product screenshot, callout pins, outcome metric strip, buyer objection sidebar.
anchors.motion: Click path reveal, before-after wipe, callout pins; avoid fake app interactions in final PDF.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use real product screenshots whenever possible; HTML-first enables clean callout overlays.

anchors.name: Civic Policy Brief
anchors.visual_thesis: A public-interest evidence brief that turns complex policy into accountable decisions.
anchors.typography: Legible institutional sans, map labels, source footers.
anchors.layout_grammar: Maps, before-after community impacts, policy levers, stakeholder matrix, funding timeline.
anchors.motion: Map layer reveal and timeline progression only.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use maps/infographics as SVG/HTML layers and keep citations visible.

anchors.name: Creative Brand Campaign
anchors.visual_thesis: The deck feels like the campaign world before the campaign exists.
anchors.typography: Brand-like display type plus clean presentation body; controlled expressive moments.
anchors.layout_grammar: Moodboard spread, campaign idea, channel map, sample executions, copy lines, visual territories.
anchors.motion: Moodboard collage reveal, copy line build, sample carousel.
anchors.html_first_notes: Use real/generated campaign visuals as full-bleed moments; avoid pure template blocks.

anchors.name: Spatial Experience Showcase
anchors.visual_thesis: A place is understood through atmosphere, path, program, and proof.
anchors.typography: Elegant architectural sans, small spatial labels, map-like captions.
anchors.layout_grammar: Full-bleed place imagery, route maps, program zones, before-after interventions, visitor moments.
anchors.motion: Pan, parallax, route tracing, reveal through doorway/window metaphors.
anchors.html_first_notes: HTML-first is essential for immersive full-bleed scenes, maps, and subtle transitions.
